description: Get profitability analysis including Gross Profit (Net Revenue - COGS), Gross Margin, Net Result (Total Income - Total Expenses), expense breakdown by COGS vs OpEx, and quarterly COGS/OpEx breakdown. Includes bank and Wise transactions with COGS categories. Note: Gross Profit (Net Revenue - COGS) is distinct from Net Result (Total Income - Total Expenses). COGS = Cost of Goods Sold (Inventory, Production Labor, Direct Contractors, Shipping). OpEx = Operating Expenses (everything else). For calendar-year periods, date_from is YYYY-01-01 and date_to is YYYY-12-31. Returns quarterly_breakdown array with COGS/OpEx per quarter.

date_from.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD). For calendar year queries use YYYY-01-01

date_to.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD). For calendar year queries use YYYY-12-31

name: get_profitability_metrics
